keyword: rural diesel pump weight and dimensions

title.en: The Rural Diesel Shipping Note Uses 800 kg and 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm
title.zh: 农村柴油泵的运输说明用 800 kg 和 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the rural diesel pump at 17 kW, 5–8 m³/h, hopper 0.2 m³ and 800 kg. The shipping inquiry copies that frame, not Diesel 30’s 2000 kg.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把农村柴油泵印成 17 kW、5–8 m³/h、料斗 0.2 m³、800 kg。运输询盘抄这个外形，不抄柴油30的 2000 kg。

h1.en: Ship the Rural Diesel Against Its Own Frame
h1.zh: 按农村柴油泵自己的外形来安排运输

directAnswer.en: For a transport question about the rural diesel pump, Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm and 800 kg, with 17 kW, 5–8 m³/h, 15 MPa, horizontal 30–50 m, vertical 10–30 m, aggregate 1–3 cm and hopper 0.2 m³. Diesel 30’s frame is 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm and 2000 kg. Putting the rural name on the Diesel 30 crate is a different order. Send the rural path, weight and dimensions to [/en/contact/](/en/contact/). No freight rate and no machine price are printed.
directAnswer.zh: 如果问的是农村柴油泵的运输，河北品锦机械（邢台）印的是 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm 和 800 kg，以及 17 kW、5–8 m³/h、15 MPa、水平 30–50 m、垂直 10–30 m、骨料 1–3 cm、料斗 0.2 m³。柴油30的外形是 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm、2000 kg。把农村泵的名字放在柴油30的箱子上，就是另一张订单。把农村泵路径、重量和外形发到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。没有印运价，也没有印机器价格。

heading.en: 17 kW is the whole engine line

body.en: There is no 4105 code on this page. Do not add one.
body.zh: 这一页没有 4105 型号。不要自行添加。

body.en: 30–50 m horizontal and 10–30 m vertical. Keep both ends.
body.zh: 水平 30–50 m，垂直 10–30 m。两端都保留。

body.en: That is smaller than the tractor page’s 0.25 m³ and Electric 20’s 0.25 m³. Quote the rural figure with the rural path.
body.zh: 它小于拖拉机页的 0.25 m³ 和电动20的 0.25 m³。农村数字要和农村路径一起引用。

answer.en: No. Diesel 30 is 56 kW and 15 m³/h.
Xingtai. No overseas warehouse is claimed.
